description: This is a server-side JavaScript source file implementing an Express.js web server. It provides API endpoints for database visualization and management, supporting multiple database types (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB). It loads environment variables from files, configures database adapters, tests connections, and serves static content and API routes.

classes.name: DatabaseAdapter
classes.description: Abstract base class defining interface for database adapters, including methods for testing connection, retrieving tables, and fetching data.

classes.name: SQLAdapter
classes.description: Abstract class extending DatabaseAdapter for SQL databases, providing implementations for executing queries and retrieving tables/data.

classes.name: PostgresAdapter
classes.description: Adapter implementing database interactions for PostgreSQL using node-postgres.

classes.name: MySQLAdapter
classes.description: Adapter implementing database interactions for MySQL using mysql2/promise.

classes.name: SQLiteAdapter
classes.description: Adapter implementing database interactions for SQLite using sqlite3.

classes.name: MongoDBAdapter
classes.description: Adapter implementing interactions with MongoDB using the mongodb driver.

methods.name: loadEnvFiles
methods.description: Loads environment variables from various .env files for each supported database type.

methods.name: testConnections
methods.description: Tests connections to all configured databases and logs results.

methods.name: handleApiRequest
methods.description: Generic handler for API requests that involves database adapter operations.

search-terms: API routes for tables and data
